diagnosis.reportedSymptom: After applying, no visible response; cancellation reports that the previous action is still awaiting confirmation.
diagnosis.reproducedDefect: An explicit cancellation used an outdated cached pending state after the native application was already confirmed.
diagnosis.nativeConstraint: The official UI hides cancellation while pendingStatus is applied, including group role checks; that pending-state guard is retained.
diagnosis.remainingUnknown: The initial lack of response in the reported player session is not established by the screenshot or this offline reproduction.

noticeDiagnosis.rootCause: A global hasDeclinedResults flag reserved the rejection footer on every result row; the available-slot notice coincided with the refusal but did not cause the height change.
noticeDiagnosis.positionCause: ShowApplicationLimit animated to a hardcoded top 16 below the position computed by LayoutResults.
noticeDiagnosis.firstAnimation: Creates one shared Motion.Start driver Frame; eight subsequent animation, scroll and dismissal cycles retain the same object count and driver.
